summary: Datacentrex, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the purchase of 23,076,923 Class A Common Units of ELNG Equity LLC for approximately $30 million, closing on August 28, 2026. The agreement includes transfer restrictions, a most-favored-nations clause for three months, and a 12-month pro-rata participation right in future ELNG debt financings. This is a private investment in an unaffiliated entity, not a transformative corporate special situation; it lacks board recommendation, premium, or strategic review mechanics. Watch for subsequent ELNG equity issuances that could trigger the MFN provision.
